articles.title: Uttarakhand HC orders decision on Dehradun drain encroachments within six months
articles.summary: The Uttarakhand High Court has directed the Dehradun district magistrate to decide within six months on a representation seeking the removal of alleged encroachments over and around a drain in Dehradun. articles.title: Bombay High Court Rules Accused Lacks Right To Inspect Crime Scene
articles.summary: The Nagpur bench of the Bombay High Court ruled that defendants have no legal right to demand a crime scene inspection. Judges stated that deciding whether an inspection is necessary rests entirely within the discretion of the trial court. This ruling clarifies procedures for evaluating evidence during ongoing criminal proceedings across the region moving forward.

articles.title: 10 venues: Kozhikode prepares the ground for school sports meet
articles.summary: KOZHIKODE: Kozhikode is gearing up to host the 68th Kerala State School Sports Meet, bringing together thousands of young athletes from across the state for a week of intense competition from October 25 to 31. Preparations in the final stages, with around 15,000 people -- including athletes, team managers, officials and organisers — expected to be involved in the meet.

articles.title: England batter Ollie Pope withdraws from Afghanistan T20 league draft amid concerns
articles.summary: England batter Ollie Pope has withdrawn from the draft for the inaugural Afghanistan Premier League (APL), which is scheduled to take place in the United Arab Emirates later this year. His decision comes amid debate over whether English cricketers should participate in the competition because of the Taliban’s treatment of women and girls in Afghanistan.
